definitions.full: H4246. mecholah [ מְחוֺלָה ] noun feminine id.; — construct מְחֹלַת Cant 7:1; plural מְחֹלֹת Exod 32:19 ; מְחֹלוֺת 15:20 5 t.; dancing , token of joyousness after victory, Judg 11:34 ; 1Sam 18:16 ; 21:12 ; 29:5 ; in worship, at feast Judg 21:21 ; act of praise to ׳י Exod 15:20 (song); in idolatrous worship 32:19 (E); as graceful and beautiful Cant 7:1; accompare by timbrel 15:20 ; Judg 11:34 , and by singing Exod 15:20 ; 1Sam 18:6 (where however read probably Po`lel Participle הַמְּחֹלְלוֺת , compare verb חוּל above; so ᵐ5 We Dr), 21:12 ; 29:5 .
